question: Which of the destination countries the demand measurement named can actually be downloaded from here?
method: Probed download.openstreetmap.fr by listing every continent directory rather than guessing paths, because that mirror answers a missing file with an HTML 404 body under HTTP 200 and a HEAD probe therefore reports every path as present. Then probed four alternative mirrors.

not_carried_by_this_mirror.GR: esim grecia 250 it, esim greece 600 en-US, griechenland inseln 4,400 de, santorini spiagge 2,200 it, meteora 26,000 en-US and 4,500 it, santorini beaches 2,500 en-US

alternatives_tested.download.geofabrik.de: carries all 14, but every request through the agent proxy is reset mid-exchange: recentRelayFailures reports ws_closed_mid_exchange after 7s with 39 bytes received. Not a remote refusal, a tunnel that does not survive this host.
alternatives_tested.osm.download.movisda.io: 404 on country paths; it serves interactive region selections, not fixed country files
alternatives_tested.ftp.spline.de/pub/openstreetmap/pbf: the whole planet only, about 80GB, against a 23GB writable allowance
alternatives_tested.overpass-api.de and two mirrors: TESTED 2026-10-02 and BLOCKED the same way Geofabrik is. overpass-api.de, overpass.kumi.systems and overpass.private.coffee all return curl 35, connection reset, on both POST and GET, and the proxy reports ws_closed_mid_exchange for overpass-api.de:443. Even /api/status, which is a few bytes, is reset. So the Overpass route named in this file as the answer for the fourteen countries is NOT available from this container either: it is not a remote refusal and not a rate limit, it is the environment network policy denying the host. Both routes to those fourteen countries now need the policy widened.

the_honest_position: Thirty-three destination countries are reachable now and none of them has a single page today, so nothing is blocked on the fourteen that are not. The fourteen are recorded here with what each is worth rather than left to be rediscovered, and two of them are large: Peru holds machu picchu at 230,000 in en-US, the biggest volume measured anywhere in this project, and Greece and Croatia together hold six measured entities across three languages. The route for them is the Overpass API, which this repository already calls in scripts/atlas/ingest/osm-overpass-market.py: Overpass answers per-layer queries against a country area and needs no full extract, at the cost of tiling the query to stay inside its runtime limit. That is work, not a wall, and it is not started because the reachable thirty-three come first. UPDATE, same day: the Overpass route was then tested and is blocked by the same tunnel failure as Geofabrik. Nothing in this repository can reach those fourteen countries until the environment allows download.geofabrik.de or an Overpass endpoint. That is an environment setting, not a code problem, and the thirty-three reachable countries are unaffected.
